name: Overcome
overview: The topic of overcoming in Scripture centers on trusting wholeheartedly in the LORD rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 instructs. Jesus assures believers in John 16:33 that despite the inevitable trials of this world, they can take heart because He has already overcome the world, providing peace amid tribulation. Philippians 4:6 encourages believers to replace anxiety with prayer and thanksgiving, presenting their requests to God as a means to experience victory over worry and difficulty. Together, these verses reveal that overcoming is rooted in faith, reliance on Christ's victory, and continual prayer.
